Class LargeMeteor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.projectiles.Projectile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.cards.projectiles.LargeMeteor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LargeMeteor extends Projectile
Represents a large meteor projectile traveling in a specific direction. It determines the outcome of the impact based on the ship's defenses and game mode, returning the corresponding Defense status.
